summary.text: John Hodgson is a Republican state representative from Kentucky House District 36 who has served since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026 against Democrat William Zorn.
He is a retired UPS Airlines executive and was operations director in the administration of Governor Matt Bevin.

paragraphs.text: John Hodgson was born in Fort Worth, Texas.
He earned a B.S. in industrial engineering from Texas Tech University in 1984 and an M.S. in aeronautical science from Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University in 2007.

His career experience includes working as division manager of aircraft maintenance planning and technical publications with UPS Airlines, operations director for Kentucky Governor Matt Bevin's administration, and president of Bigfoot Strategies.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he moved to Kentucky with UPS in 1985 and retired after 32 years there in senior leadership positions.

Hodgson has served as policy director of the Kentucky board for Americans for Election Integrity, chair of the Fisherville Area Neighborhood Association, president of the Louisville Tea Party, and legislative district 36 chair of the Jefferson County Republican Party.

He succeeded Republican Jerry T. Miller in District 36 and in the 2025-2026 session served as vice chair of the Elections, Const. Amendments & Intergovernmental Affairs Committee and as a member of the Small Business & Information Technology, House State Government and House Transportation committees.
In his 2026 survey he said he supports a constitutionally limited government and efficient, tax-efficient government policy.
